name: geode_cosmos
theme: a mineral-first full-scale dive — inward from an amethyst geode's crystal shell through quartz's spiral-chain lattice and the iron-lit flaw running across it, into the nucleus and out across the cosmic web to a nursery nebula and a ringed world, then home over night karst country and the flooded cave that holds the geode

registers.name: geode_cavern
registers.palette: deep violet points and gold glints on sooty grey
registers.scene: inside an amethyst geode, a rounded cavern walled on every side by violet quartz points, ranks of six-sided crystals standing inward from the whole shell, sooty grey rind behind their bases, gold glints struck along the sharpest edges, no floor and no sky, crystal in every direction

registers.name: blade_crossing
registers.palette: cold violet glass and blue-white edge light
registers.scene: amethyst blades crossing at angles, six-sided columns wedged over and under one another, their faces stepped in shallow growth terraces, violet chevron banding standing in the glass under every face, blue-white light carried along the edges, black rock crumbs settled in the angles

registers.name: quartz_lattice
registers.palette: gold chains and violet glow on black
registers.scene: the atomic lattice of quartz, silicon and oxygen linked into spiral chains that turn three steps to a full twist, chain beside chain in ranks receding into black depth, every tetrahedron joined at its corners to the next, violet light standing in the open channels down the middle of the spirals, gold glints at the joins

registers.name: defect_line
registers.palette: gold-hot break in a cold violet grid
registers.scene: a break in the quartz lattice, one rank of spiral chains ending against the next, the rows on either side bent out of true to meet across the mismatch, iron atoms sitting foreign and gold-hot in a line along the break, violet colour standing in the grid around them, the ordered ranks running on undisturbed beyond

registers.name: nucleus_droplet
registers.scene: deep inside the atom, a tight droplet of packed glowing spheres held in an indigo dark, taut strands of light strung between them, violet fog standing all around it, faint sparks strewn through the space beyond

registers.name: cosmic_web
registers.palette: gold filaments and violet sheets on black
registers.scene: the cosmic web strung through the void, gold filaments of galaxies drawn between glowing knots, huge black cells opening between the strands, violet sheets of light stretched across the widest gaps, knot after knot receding into the black, one blue-white spiral galaxy burning at a near crossing

registers.name: spiral_galaxy
registers.palette: blue-white arms, indigo dust lanes, gold core
registers.scene: a spiral galaxy tilted across the black, arms of blue-white star crowds wound out from a gold core, indigo dust lanes cut along the inner side of every arm, globular swarms hanging above and below the disc, violet gas banked in the arms where new stars gather

registers.name: nursery_nebula
registers.palette: violet and indigo gas with hot gold stars on black
registers.scene: a star-nursery nebula, towering columns of violet and indigo gas standing upright across the black, ranked one behind another into the depth, gold newborn stars burning inside the column heads, banks of dust lit from within along their flanks, thin gas threads drawn between them, black sky opening in the gaps
registers.loop_target: a nebula of violet columns standing upright across the black, gold newborn stars burning inside their heads

registers.name: ringed_world
registers.palette: indigo seas and cold silver rings
registers.scene: a ringed world turned in the black, deep indigo seas under sparse storm swirls, a ridged grey-white continent spread along the edge of its night side, a broad tilted ring system combed into hundreds of bright and dark bands, the rings' shadow laid in a hard line across the seas, two small moons out beyond the ring edge

registers.name: karst_country
registers.palette: indigo night, silver mist, one gold-violet glow
registers.scene: karst country seen from high above at night, hundreds of limestone towers standing out of black gorges, moonlit mist lying in the low ground between them, wet jungle cover on every summit, a crooked river drawn in silver through the middle of it, one cave mouth burning gold-violet at the foot of a tower

registers.name: cave_chamber
registers.palette: wet black stone, blue-green glow threads, gold glints
registers.scene: a flooded chamber under the karst, wet black flowstone ribbing the walls in long folds, bats roosting in tight clusters overhead, cave crickets stilled on the ledges, colourless fish holding in the black pool below, threads of blue-green glow strung down from the ceiling, gold glints on the wet stone, one pocket broken open low in the wall with violet light standing in it

music_theme: an amethyst cavern opening into the deep sky — a slow mineral breath, reed organ over a deep sub pulse, cold violet and gold, widening as the scale opens and settling back into stone at the close
